settings.heading: This is liqueur with a twist – handcrafted, bold in flavour, and bottled in the iconic Mason Jar.

settings.text: Hier gibt’s Likör, der anders ist – handgemacht, stark im Geschmack und abgefüllt im ikonischen Mason Jar.

Moonshine used to be the outlaws’ drink – distilled in secret, hidden in jars, and sipped with attitude. Today, it’s a statement: of flavour, craft, and the joy of having something truly special in your glass. Curious what’s inside? Scroll on and discover our damn tasty flavours – your glass will thank you.

settings.heading: IS MOONSHINE LEGAL?
settings.row_content:
Nope. Distilling alcohol at home to sell is still very much illegal.

But don’t worry – our Moonshine is 100% legal and professionally made. Crafted with care, no shortcuts on flavour.

settings.heading: HOW DO YOU DRINK MOONSHINE?
settings.row_content: However you like: straight, on the rocks, or mixed into a cocktail – depending on the flavour and your mood. Our fruity varieties are super refreshing when ice-cold – perfect for summer. Our tip? Try it neat first. Then shake it, mix it, or chill it your way.

settings.heading: WHY IS THE LIQUEUR IN A JAR INSTEAD OF A BOTTLE?
settings.row_content: Because we honour our roots – and the jar beats any bottle. The Mason Jar is a tribute to the Moonshiners of the 1920s, who used jars to hide their outlawed spirits. Today, it stands for honest flavour, a drink with history – and tons of upcycling potential: from drinking glass to pantry hero.

settings.heading: HOW STRONG IS YOUR MOONSHINE?
settings.row_content: Our fruity, nutty and creamy liqueurs range from 16% to 25% ABV – bold in flavour, strong in character. Want more? Our Vodka hits 40%, the High Proof goes to 50% ABV, and the High High Proof hits a wild 72% ABV.

settings.heading: WHAT MAKES O’DONNELL MOONSHINE SPECIAL?
settings.row_content: We don’t do things halfway. O’Donnell Moonshine stands for handcrafted liqueur, honest ingredients, and flavours that stick with you – all bottled in our iconic Mason Jar. No standard bottles. No standard drinks. Just a true experience in a glass. More than liqueur. Made for those who take taste seriously.
